verdict.rationale: Cloudflare MoQ Relay is a managed media-streaming relay service, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only relay creation, token management and expiration via the API and dashboard. Nothing shows recurring schedules, cron-like triggers, or workflow automation. Token expiration times are an adjacent control, not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
